messages:
Marta: Quick sanity run for the new model (nova-7b) quant profiles across eu/us/apac. Results + artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/nova7b/2002109876/

benchbot: job finished: quant_profile_matrix / 200 models x 3 regions. artifacts: gs://redwood-bench/nova7b/2002109876/artifacts.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

Kevin: Nice, can you paste the p50/p95 + tps numbers and which kernels were used? Any big diff H100 vs A100?

Marta: Ran FP16/BF16 baseline, INT8 PTQ, and FP8 (E4M3). Kernels: H100 -> custom_matmul_v3 (fused); A100 -> torch_fused_matmul. Summary (per-request decode, batch=1, 512 tokens):
- H100 FP8: p50 18ms, p95 45ms, tokens/s ~950
- A100 INT8: p50 26ms, p95 70ms, tokens/s ~620
- BF16 baseline (H100): p50 22ms, p95 55ms, tokens/s ~780
Quality (vs BF16 baseline): FP8 ΔPPL +0.6%, INT8 ΔPPL +1.8% (note codegen slice shows higher delta)

Priya: Any region network tail? apac tends to add noise.

Marta: Region breakdown (same GPU images): us-west2 p95 +2-3ms vs eu-west1; asia-east1 p95 +8-12ms. GPU kernel perf near-identical; extra tail comes from shard warmup and image cache miss in apac.

Alex: Quick table snippet
```
region,gpu,profile,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_s,quality_delta_ppl
us-west2,H100,FP8,18,45,950,+0.6%
eu-west1,H100,FP8,19,47,930,+0.6%
asia-east1,H100,FP8,26,58,700,+0.9%
us-west2,A100,INT8,26,70,620,+1.8%
```

Jun: Rollout question: our guardrail is 2% PPL degrade. INT8 at 1.8% is borderline — can we do hybrid (first K layers BF16, rest INT8)? What perf tradeoff?

Marta: ran hybrid (first 6 layers BF16, rest INT8): tokens/s ~820, p95 ~50ms, quality ΔPPL +0.9% — meets guardrail and saves ~5% cost vs BF16 baseline.

Kevin: Any NaN/instability with FP8 on H100? Codegen tasks can be sensitive.

Marta: No NaNs observed in main runs but saw 2 divergences on codegen prompt set with FP8 (logit diff >1e-2 on step 1). Marked those slices and flagged to eval team, recommend disabling FP8 for codegen-heavy routes until we patch kernel quant scale clipping.

benchbot: artifacts + logs: gs://redwood-bench/nova7b/2002109876/{artifacts.tar.gz,perf.csv,eval_slices.json}. CI job 5467 (success)

Alex: I'll add per-route qprofile and kernel override flags in rollout doc + console. Will push draft: /docs/rollouts/nova7b-quant.md

Marta: Thanks — next steps: (1) run more FP8 reproducibility on codegen slice with wider RNG seeds, (2) reproduce hybrid at batch=4 latency, (3) cost calc for Dedicated pools. Ping me for infra quota if you need more H100 in apac.
